build_conv_layer: build a standard 2D convolution layer with optional batch norm and ELU non-linearity using make_conv_layer
build_separable_conv_layer: build a depthwise separable 2D convolution layer with optional batch norm using make_conv_sep2d_layer
create_weight_variable: create a randomly initialized weight variable with configurable shape and standard deviation using weight_variable
create_bias_variable: create a zero-initialized bias variable with the given shape using bias_variable
apply_batch_norm: apply batch normalization to a convolution output tensor using batch_norm_layer
